the 360°-experience is considered an interesting addition to TV-viewing and people would like to use it more often, but that the quality of the content on the different devices is an important factor.
the multi-device set-up is considered a social TV-experience, even though the HMD isolates the user.

the design of immersive TV- experiences, which are based on the integration of multiple devices.
the question how to create a multi-screen experience that can be considered as a social activity, which is not limited to the TV-set.

the question whether the multi-device set-up can be considered a social experience, how the content is perceived in the different set-ups, how the experience can be improved, and how the experience can become more accessible.

the 360°-experience is a promising addition to regular TV-content, but the quality of the experience should be improved.
this experience is a social one, but it is not yet ready to replace the traditional TV experience.
the 360° content is an experience that can be used in a social setting and can be enjoyed in a team, even though the HMD is isolating.

the experience was considered to be a social one, even with the HMD.
people are willing to engage with 360° content, even when it is displayed on a regular TV-screen.
people are interested in the 360° content and they are willing to explore the content on different devices.
